author: Axiom III
title: CES Replication (Axiom III): Emit R2@+2 recovery sentinel
abstract: Emits Axiom III CES recovery beacon at +2 with numeric sentinel_delta to assess restoration after S1–S3.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.emit_endurance_beacon import emit

out = emit(agent='Axiom III',
           label='CES:R2_recovery@+2',
           value=1230,                   # recovery below S3=1315 indicates partial restoration
           field='sentinel_delta',
           path_complexity_est=1.0)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
